three.js r170 (npm three@0.170.0), MIT — see LICENSE. Only the files BeeZilla's 3D painter needs: the core module and three add-ons (GLTFLoader, OrbitControls, BufferGeometryUtils, which GLTFLoader reads), plus GLTFExporter, which the painter does NOT use (it patches the .glb itself: /buzzy/glb-patch.js) but the browser probes (scripts/probe-model-paint.mjs, probe-paint-on-board.mjs) use to make their test models. The add-ons' bare 'three' imports were changed to the relative core path, so no import map is needed.
